title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is a paper signal, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. A single trade, open or closed, says nothing about a strategy. The snapshot below was read at 2026-11-07T08:40:18.299Z, and the record updates continuously as new closes are processed. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## What is open now

The engine-level records show 0 positions open on paper for htf-rsi-v007, trend-daily-v005, and trend-daily-v006. Separately, a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close, and that position is no longer open. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. Because the trend engines show 0 positions open on paper, their current recorded exposure is flat, while the NEAR position remains open and unresolved. Paper signals only means no real orders are placed anywhere in this record, so every entry and exit above is recorded state rather than executed trading.

## What has closed

ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule that closed it was a break below the 10-day low, and the recorded measurement at that close was 1.703. The ATOM result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is a single completed trade, and one trade says nothing about a strategy. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade, so the record does not provide a numeric average for those 4 closed trades. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, so those 6 closed trades belong to that live window. v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026, so those 7 closed trades belong to that live window. In testing, losing trades were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A closed trade is a completed round trip, not an open exposure, and these averages describe closed trades only.

## What the market filter is allowing

The Bitcoin market filter is off for trend-daily-v005 and for trend-daily-v006. A market filter that is off means the trend engines are not allowing new trend entries under that filter, and both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper. The Bitcoin market filter being off is a state reading, not a prediction about Bitcoin or about any symbol listed. For trend-daily-v005, the symbols closest to their 20-day breakout are ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high, BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high, and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high. The same three distances appear for trend-daily-v006: ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high, BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high, and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high. ZECUSDT is the closest of the three at -0.55% below its high, while BNBUSDT is 8.71% below and ETHUSDT is 9.50% below. These readings are distances to breakout levels, not predictions of whether a breakout will occur, and they do not by themselves open a position.

## Where to verify

The record is not a forecast and does not predict the next close. It is a live read of engine state, and it updates continuously. Because the record updates continuously, any later snapshot can differ from the one above. The snapshot time above is the moment this state was read; later reads may show different open positions, closed counts, or distances. The performance page, the signal log, and the status posted to the channel are the places where the same numbers are posted. If a position opens or closes, those pages and logs will show the change.
